phases.title: Foundations
phases.goal: HK live, Shopify opgezet, design klaar, alle infra

tasks.name: HK bedrijf oprichten
tasks.notes: Sales of record = HK entity | MERGED 2026-09-10 (audit): includes HK bank (f0-1), WISE (f0-2), Currency Ways (f0-3). 4 accounts openen op vrijdag 12 sept in deze volgorde: HK entity → HK bank → WISE → Currency Ways. Owner: Kheibar.

tasks.name: Returns policy (14 dgn, wij betalen)
tasks.notes: EU wettelijk minimum | MERGED 2026-09-10 (audit): omvat returns policy 14 dgn (origineel f0-19) + returns portal opzetten Returnless/Loop/Shopify Afterpay (f0-38). Eén workflow: policy opstellen + portal activeren. Owner: Hermes.

tasks.name: ICP / buyer persona × 3 segmenten (EU25-45 home cook)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Geen doelgroep = geen ads die werken. Voedt ad copy, supplier pick, listing volgorde.

tasks.name: Brand promise / value prop (1 zin, <12 woorden)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Zonder dit kan logo/design/copy niet gemaakt worden. Alles hangt af van 1 zin.

tasks.name: Logistics 3PL shortlist (PostNL / DHL / 3PL hub NL)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Drop ship China = 7-14d. 3PL buffer of EU warehouse is table stakes voor €10k/mnd.

tasks.name: Carrier SLA onderzoek (transit times, fail rate, returns ease)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Wave 1 €35/d = direct afhankelijk van conversion rate; carrier fail = negatieve reviews na 2 orders.

tasks.name: HACCP / food-contact compliance per materiaal (LFGB / FDA)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — AVB verzekering f0-20 dekt aansprakelijkheid, maar HACCP/LFGB materiaal-cert is verplicht voor food-contact keukengerij. Zonder = recall risico.

tasks.name: CX tool keuze (Gorgias vs Zendesk vs Shopify Inbox alleen)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Inbox widget f0-25 staat, maar geen tool-decision. 7 talen → Gorgias macros bespaart 4u/dag.

tasks.name: Tracking & UTM taxonomy (source/medium/campaign/content standaard)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Zonder UTM discipline is attribution onmogelijk; kill rules werken niet. Wave 1 budget €35/d weggegooid geld.

tasks.name: Pixel event taxonomy (ViewContent / AddToCart / InitiateCheckout / Purchase + CAPI)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — iOS 14.5+ = CAPI vereist voor Meta ads. Zonder server-side events trainen ads op junk.

tasks.name: Insurance scope review (product liability + carriage + cyber)
tasks.notes: HIGH — AVB f0-20 alleen. HK → EU drop ship heeft carriage liability risico; cyber voor Shopify/Klaviyo data.

phases.title: Brand + Product Setup
phases.goal: Brand name, logo, 10 producten gekozen, listings in voorbereiding

tasks.name: Product onderzoek (10 producten)
tasks.done: Top 10 gekozen maar moet nog researchen.

tasks.name: Material composition disclosure per SKU
tasks.notes: Allergens per product | MERGED 2026-09-10 (audit): omvat material composition (origineel f1-21), country of origin marking (f1-22), manufacturer address (f1-23). Eén spreadsheet artifact per SKU. Owner: Farshad.

tasks.name: Competitor prijspeil per SKU (5 concurrents, €/marge check)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Pricing f2-5 kan pas als competitor prijzen bekend zijn. Anders margin niet te bepalen.

tasks.name: Marketing angle stack × 10 SKUs (3 angles/SKU, hook + body)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Zonder angle stack is UGC/video creatie (f2-10/11) rammen in het donker.

tasks.name: Founder-led content kalender (Ali face-to-camera, 3/wk start D2)
tasks.notes: HIGH — HEARTH/keuken-merk zonder founder presence = anoniem. Organisch groeit niet mee met ads.

tasks.name: Influencer seeding wave 0 (10 micro-influencers, gratis product)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Voor Wave 1 ads heb je social proof. 10 micro-influencers met 5-50K volgers = UGC + credibility.

tasks.name: User research: 8 interviews met NL/BE/DU home cooks
tasks.notes: HIGH — Vervangt ICP aannames met echte taal + pain points. Voedt angle stack en copy.

tasks.name: Brand ambassadeurs program setup (15% korting + unieke link)
tasks.notes: MEDIUM — Stook retention + laag-CAC kanaal naast Meta.

tasks.name: Catalog feed setup (Google Merchant Center + Meta catalog)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Voor Google Ads f2-15 EN Meta dynamic ads. Zonder feed kun je niet targeten op product-viewers.

tasks.name: SEO content plan (10 P0 keywords, 5 cornerstone blogs D14)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Paid ads alleen = CAC stijgt. SEO content voor long-tail is compounding channel.

phases.title: Listings + Wave 1 Launch
phases.goal: 10 product listings live, Wave 1 (3-4 SKUs) eerste ads

tasks.name: Trust badges + reviews app (Judge.me)
tasks.notes: MERGED 2026-09-10 (audit): omvat Trust badges + reviews app Judge.me install (origineel f2-7) + review velocity setup (f2-21). Owner: Designer (install) + Hermes (velocity automation).

tasks.name: Creative testing framework (3 hooks × 3 bodies per ad, kill rule)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — Zonder framework = elke week nieuwe ads zonder learning. Creative refresh elke 14 dgn (f4-4) heeft framework nodig.

tasks.name: Trustpilot profiel openen (uitnodigingsflow na delivery)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Externe trust badge naast Judge.me; Google Seller Ratings in ads.

tasks.name: WhatsApp / SMS abandonment flow (naast email)
tasks.notes: HIGH — EU cart abandonment via SMS/WhatsApp >40% open vs email 15%.

tasks.name: Inventory / SKU ops dashboard (daily stock per SKU, backorder alerts)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Dropship + Wave 1 = real-time stock visibility nodig. Anders ad naar OOS = wasted spend.

tasks.name: Logistieke first-mile audit (China supplier → 3PL → klant lead times)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Beloofde delivery in listing vs realiteit. Gap = 1-star reviews.

tasks.name: Andromeda test: 100 AI creatives vs 5 hand-crafted
tasks.notes: Source: roslanofficial (DXZrPcRAAZk). KB cluster-001. '100 AI generated now beat 5 hand-crafted'

tasks.name: ABO testing campaign: per segment, 3-7 dagen
Indirect sales template: product in context (koken)
tasks.notes: Source: roslanofficial. KB cluster-001. 'People hate offer right away'

tasks.name: Creative diversity checklist: geen overlap
tasks.notes: Source: roslanofficial. KB cluster-001. 'Every creative completely different'

tasks.name: Mockup workflow: floating video + Zara-style
tasks.notes: Source: roslanofficial. KB cluster-000. 'Exhute AI for mass production'

tasks.name: Build 3-campaign structure: Interest + Creative + Retargeting
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell (YT-_jqhFeUu8QE). KB cluster-168 (creative_campaign_ad). '3 campaigns: interest testing + creative testing + retargeting'

tasks.name: Per ad set: 5 totally unique ad creatives (no variation templates)
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-168. '5 unique creatives, no two alike — Andromeda requirement'

tasks.name: Rotate winning creatives from Creative Testing → Interest Testing weekly
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-168. 'Proven winners move to scaling campaign'

tasks.name: Every ad = 5 unique primary text + 5 headlines + 5 descriptions
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-168. 'Long/medium/short + features/benefits/review/lifestyle'

tasks.name: Duplicate ad set 5x with different audiences (no overlap)
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-168. 'Same ads in 5 audiences = full context coverage'

tasks.name: Map creatives to funnel positions (top/mid/bottom)
tasks.notes: Source: Maryanne Damarzo + Charley T. KB cluster-159. Top=curiosity/shock, mid=benefit/us-vs-them, bottom=proof/offer

tasks.name: Hook formula: curiosity + initial shock + specific benefit
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-159. 'Drive curiosity, deliver shock, give benefit'

tasks.name: Mid-funnel ads focused on benefits + us-vs-them angle
tasks.notes: Source: Maryanne Damarzo. KB cluster-159. 'Mid-funnel = super straightforward benefit ad'

tasks.name: Add fresh ads every 7-10 days (fatigue prevention)
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-159. 'CPM + frequency = fatigue signal. Rotate before fatigue hits'

tasks.name: Headline = stop-the-scroll weapon (sub-headline expands offer)
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-109. 'Headline first, sub-headline next — same intent, different words'

tasks.name: Opening sentence must work standalone (without headline)
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-109. 'First sentence does the heavy lifting'

tasks.name: Headline targets a niche segment, not 'everyone'
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-109. 'Goal is not to grab the world's attention'

tasks.name: Optimize conversion rate BEFORE scaling ads
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-145. 'CRO gets negated when you change ads'

tasks.name: Optimize on 7-day click conversions (real purchase signal)
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-145. '7-day click > 1-day for purchase decisions'

tasks.name: Don't copy competitor ads 1:1 — you'll get worse results
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-145. 'If you rip off everyone, you do worse than them'

tasks.name: Flexible ads math: 3×2×2 = 12 combinations per ad
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-169. '5 flexible ads × 12 = 60 combinations (deck of cards strategy)'

tasks.name: Use flexible ads inside ad sets (less fragmentation)
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-169. 'Multiple flexible ads > multiple ad sets'

tasks.name: Track blended CPA (not per-ad CPA)
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-110. '$85 ad at 105 AOV may be better than $92 ad at 160 AOV'

tasks.name: LTV math: 10K customers × $1K LTV = $10M LTV pool
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-110. 'LTV pool = ceiling for ad spend'

tasks.name: Test 3 offer tiers (low/mid/high AOV)
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-110. '$100/$150/$300 offers = blended AOV growth'

tasks.name: ROAS benchmarks: 3.09 average @ €78k spend (Chase case)
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-161. '86.8% ROAS increase from fixing account structure'

tasks.name: Cutting spend 35% can rescue losing campaign
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-161. '$94k → $91k swing unprofitable → profitable'

tasks.name: Native-style ads (zero text overlay) outperform explicit ads
tasks.notes: Source: Maryanne Damarzo. KB cluster-124. 'Disguised content beats banner-style ads'

tasks.name: Every ad has ONE purpose: stop the scroll
tasks.notes: Source: Chase Chappell. KB cluster-124. 'Design from the constraint of one purpose'

tasks.name: Cohort LTV analyse per traffic source (Meta vs Google vs Organic vs Direct)
tasks.notes: HIGH — LTV:CAC beslissing (f4-2 scale) hangt af van source-quality, niet alleen SKU-winners.

tasks.name: CRO scan homepage + PDP, 1 conversion lift actie
tasks.notes: MEDIUM — CRO lift 10-20% > nieuwe ads. Onderbenut.

tasks.name: Prijs-elasticiteit test per top-3 SKU (€X / €X+2 / €X-2)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Sommige SKUs zijn +€5-premium-positie, andere -€5-budget. Geen test = blinde pricing.

tasks.name: Crisis comms runbook (recall, supplier fail, ad disapprove wave, chargeback spike)
tasks.notes: CRITICAL — F5-12 staat op D90+ maar 1 chargeback-golf in Wave 1 zonder runbook = 1 week paniek.

tasks.name: CBO scaling campaign: alleen winners
tasks.notes: Source: roslanofficial. KB cluster-001. 'CBO grows only stronger'

tasks.name: Weekly review: kill vs focus routine
Scale winners in 20% step-ups (Charley methodology)
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-161. 'Gradual increase maintains performance; jumps break the algorithm'

tasks.name: Email = build relationship (readers look forward to receiving)
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-137. 'Build relationship, not broadcast'

tasks.name: Every email = value-packed story FIRST, then ask for sale
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-137. 'Story before ask — never both at once'

tasks.name: Weekly or daily newsletter cadence
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-137. '7-day engagement cycle wins'

tasks.name: Email sequences: welcome + abandoned cart + post-purchase
tasks.notes: Source: Copy That!. KB cluster-137. 'Build relationships with weekly engagement'

tasks.name: Cohort LTV:CAC analysis (track repeat buyers by acquisition month)
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-110. '10K customers × $1K LTV = $10M pool'

tasks.name: Track repeat-buyer cohorts separately from one-time buyers
tasks.notes: Source: Charley T. KB cluster-110. 'Dividing by repeat vs first-time reveals true CAC'

phases.title: Scale Winners
phases.goal: Budget omhoog op winners, repeat halo start

tasks.name: Wholesale / B2B pilot onderzoek (5 lokale winkels, NL/BE/DU)
tasks.notes: MEDIUM — Na 90 dgn traction is wholesale vaak 2x LTV met lagere CAC. Onderzocht, niet gecommit.

tasks.name: EU uitbreiding pack (vertalingen, douane, lokale payment)
tasks.notes: MEDIUM — EU10 shopify markets staat, maar operationele EU-uitrol is niet gepland.

tasks.name: Brand extension brainstorm (HEARTH-adjacent: badkamer, tuin, dining)
Mentor / advisor call (iemand die 2x €10k/mnd heeft gedaan)
tasks.notes: HIGH — Lessons learned heeft externe check nodig, anders herhaal je dezelfde fouten.

tasks.name: Persoonlijke health check (Ali - burnout signals, founder mode)
tasks.notes: HIGH — 90 dgn launch = burnout risico. Post-launch assessment voor jaar 2.
